Q912.reason: Robbery needs a taking by force or fear, and the owner was not put in fear, so the offence stops at attempted robbery; false pretenses requires actual reliance on the false statement, which the owner did not have.

Q925.reason: Betty's Greenacre gift over ("ever consumed") can vest beyond any life in being and is void under the Rule Against Perpetuities, leaving Friend with the fee; Blackacre's condition is tied to Associate's lifetime, so it is valid and Betty takes.

Q933.reason: The oral microbiota is commonly cited as more than 500 bacterial species in standard microbiology texts, and molecular surveys have since found even more, so 500 is the closest option.
